kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

lines.say: Before you close your eyes, say this to yourself.
lines.big: Before you close your eyes, say this to yourself

lines.say: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee. Psalm one sixteen, verse seven.
lines.big: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

lines.say: Tell your own soul to rest. He's been good to you.
lines.big: Tell your own soul to rest. He's been good to you.

lines.say: Lord, I'm returning to my rest tonight. You've dealt bountifully with me. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 105 through 124, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
